newsitem.title: USA: Tenneco expects La. gas line back Friday.
newsitem.headline: Tenneco expects La. gas line back Friday.

text.p: Tennessee Gas Pipeline, a unit of Tenneco Energy, said Wednesday it expected its Louisiana gas line, shut Tuesday due to a gas leak, to be back in service by Friday.
"They're repairing the line now, and it should be back in service Friday. All restrictions will be lifted for the gas day Friday," a company spokesman said.

The leak in the 20-inch 500 line, which runs from Kinder (station 823) to Natchitoche (station 40), cut 250 million cubic feet per day from secondary service upstream of station 823. No primary service was affected.
The spokesman said the cause of the leak had not been determined.
